## 简体中文

- 修复仓库更名后的更新下载路径：v1.10.2 及后续客户端在下载前，将兼容清单中的 `ZjDing989/LionSSH` 地址转换为 `ZjDing42/LionSSH`，新版的更新检查与安装包下载均直接使用新仓库地址。
- 保留旧版客户端所需的兼容更新清单，签名校验保持不变。覆盖 Windows 安装版与免安装版、macOS Intel / Apple Silicon，以及 Linux AppImage。
- 已安装的 v1.9.6 / v1.10.1 仍按原来的更新逻辑升级；安装 v1.10.2 后生效。旧地址不可用时，可从本页直接下载安装包完成升级。

## English

- Fix update downloads after the repository rename: before downloading, v1.10.2 and later clients convert legacy `ZjDing989/LionSSH` URLs in the compatibility feed to `ZjDing42/LionSSH`. Both update checks and package downloads use the current repository directly.
- Retain the compatibility feed for older clients and preserve signature verification. Applies to Windows installers and portable ZIPs, macOS Intel / Apple Silicon, and Linux AppImage.
- Existing v1.9.6 / v1.10.1 installations use their original update logic for this upgrade; the fix takes effect after installing v1.10.2. If the old address is unavailable, download the package directly from this release page.
